name: smwpatches-event-camera-scroll
title: Event Camera Scroll
description:
This patch allows you to make the camera scroll to a specified location before running an event, and then return back to its original position afterwards. You can set a different position for every event, and of course set events to not scroll at all (also the effect only applies to the Main Overworld map for obvious reasons).
To use, just edit the tables in "event_camera_scroll_tables.asm", then patch "event_camera_scroll.asm".
